text: Mi Home Dishwash Round Bar (500g)
MRP
Product Description:

Slow-Dissolving Dish Wash bar has a special polymer that prevents the formation of white film on washed dishes. The product is specially designed to minimise wastage while providing total cleaning of your dishes.
Net Content: 500g

Directions for use: Take a small amount of bar on a wet sponge or dish wash cloth. Wet the dish and rub the sponge or dishcloth directly on the dish to create lather. Wash and rinse thoroughly. Use as needed to wash dishes. Keep the bar dry between uses to extend its lifespan. For external use only.
Storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and children.
Manufactured by: Kanani Industries, Survey No .- 183/1/P, Besides Ashapura Agro Ind.,Near Canal, Bavla-Sanand Road, At - Lodariyal, Dist .- Ahmedabad-382 213 (Gujarat)
Marketed by: Mi Lifestyle Marketing Global Private Limited, No.25, G.N. Chetty Road, T. Nagar, Chennai - 600017, Tamil Nadu.
Shelf Life: Use before 24 months from the date of manufacture.

Additional Information: Mi Home Antibacterial Dishwash Round Bar is a solid dishwashing product designed to effectively clean dishes while being gentle on hands. It contains antibacterial agents that help eliminate germs and bacteria commonly found on dishes. This product typically has a mild, pleasant fragrance, though specific scents may vary product to product.Used for: Manual dishwashing. Suitable for most types of dishes and cookware.Benefits: Gentle on hands while being tough on grease and stains. Packaging may be recyclable or made from recycled materials, which can indirectly help reduce environmental impact.

Mi Home Toilet Cleaner (500ml)
MRP
Product description:
Kill & Shine Toilet Cleaner is made from an advanced "colour change" formula that gets rid of tough lime scale and provides a sparkling shine to your toilet.
Net Content: 500ml

Directions for use: Shake the bottle before use. Apply directly under the rim and on the sides of the toilet bowl. Let it sit for at least 10 minutes before scrubbing with a toilet brush. Flush after cleaning. Use as needed for maintaining a clean and hygienic toilet.
Ingredients: Hydrochloric Acid 13% w/v, Oleyl Amine Ethoxylate, Alkyl Trimethyl Ammonium Chloride, Butylated Hydroxy Toluene, DM Water, Fragrance, C.I. No. 42090
Storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and heated sources. Keep out of reach of children and pets.

Mi Home Liquid Laundry Detergent (500ml) MRP
Product Description:

Foaming liquid detergent provides great cleaning of your laundry with very little quantity. It has a special stain -removing enzyme and a brightening agent to give your clothes- white or coloured- a sparkling cleanliness. You will also love the long lasting fragrant feel of your clothes after every wash.
Net Content: 500ml
Directions for use: Use one capful per load for regular washing cycles; for heavily soiled clothes, use two capfuls.
Ingredients: Anionic detergent, Non Ionic Optical brightener, enzyme, colour & fragrance.
Storage: Store in the original container in a cool, dry place away from sunlight. Keep out of reach of children.

Mi Home Floor Cleaner (500ml)
Product Description:

This disinfectant floor cleaner is formulated to effectively clean and disinfect various types of flooring surfaces, including tiles, wood, laminate, and linoleum. It combines cleaning agents with disinfecting properties to provide a thorough and hygienic cleaning experience. The formulation ensures that it not only removes dirt and grime but also kills a broad spectrum of germs and bacteria, leaving surfaces sanitized.
Net Content: 500ml

Directions for use: Floors, Bathrooms & Tiles: Use one capful in half a bucket of water (4 Litres). Gently mop the surface.Kitchen Surface: Apply undiluted on dirty area. Leave for 10 minutes and rinse.
Ingredients: Benzalkonium Chloride Solution (50%) - 4 % W/v, Excipients, DM Water, Perfume, CI No. 14720
